about: Every asset in SCION 31's threshold film: where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it. Rights unknown = not used.

assets.what: the dog: 13 matted archive frames on screen (9 and 12-15 watching and turning, 26/28/31 the turn through its front, 43-45/48 the head-low walk, 5 for the head turned away); all 50 frames are matted
assets.operation: SAM outline -> anti-aliased coverage prior -> fur-class trimap (erode 2 / dilate 3) -> colour-line alpha against locally extended F and B, confidence-weighted with the prior -> guided filter (r1, eps 2e-4) -> alpha contrast curve 0.06..0.94 -> foreground colour by inverting the compositing equation, clamped to +-0.15 of the extended interior (decontamination) -> premultiplied RGBA (build/prep_dog.py, build/lib_matte.py); in the film: mirrored for the head-low walk, scaled 1.55 in premultiplied form, regraded for dusk with per-frame grain inside alpha, light-wrapped

assets.what: the dog lying (refusal and the sill): RECONSTRUCTION, the source has no lying dog
assets.source_file: dog-mattes frame 9 (body, legs, head) and frame 15 (head turned away)
assets.operation: one solved matte split by complementary soft masks into body / forelegs / hind legs / head; forelegs pivoted forward at the elbow, hind legs compressed under the haunch, body lowered, head pivoted at the neck or substituted (premultiplied dissolve); belly cut given a synthesized fringe (labelled reconstruction); whole matte mirrored for the refusal; pieces composited with union alpha where they meet (interior forced solid), head-back piece cut only across the neck so skull and ears keep their own matte edge
hand-drawn trimap outline (build/polys.py WOMAN_F000) -> hair/fabric-class band (erode 4 / dilate 3) -> same solver -> premultiplied; graded near-silhouette for dusk; cropped at the hip as she sits

assets.what: the person's legs (standing, stepping, sitting with knees up)
assets.operation: drawn: anti-aliased polygons (reconstruction: the source frame is cut at the thigh)

assets.what: the reaching and the low offered hand + forearm
assets.operation: SAM hand outline unioned with a drawn forearm outline (the card it holds is excluded) -> trimap (erode 7 / dilate 4) -> solver -> premultiplied; mirrored, scaled, rotated in premultiplied form

assets.what: the door leaf and its curtained window
assets.operation: SAM leaf outline -> hard (painted wood) class trimap (erode 1 / dilate 2) -> solver; quad rectified to a flat leaf; the window's sheer curtain as a luminance-keyed fabric density (alpha) that the room light passes through; leaf swung by per-column foreshortening

assets.what: the dusk clouds, and the haze density in the door's beam
assets.source_title: Top Of The Cloud - Time Lapse (Wide Screen 16:9)
assets.operation: smoke class: trimap from saturation (sure sky / sure cloud) -> colour-line alpha against the extended blue sky -> guided filter -> foreground desaturated and its blue clamped (the sky's blue spill removed) -> premultiplied; interpolated between frames in premultiplied form; regraded to dusk

assets.what: house facade, porch boards, door casing and sill, steps, sky gradient, tree line, room interior and lamp, door light spill, beam, cast shadow, grain, vignette
assets.operation: computed (numpy). The tree line is a computed fractional matte (foliage edge class). The dog's cast shadow is its own alpha projected onto the floor.

assets.what: dusk air, crickets, the voice (calls, soft words), claws on boards, door creak, room air, rustle, lying down, sigh
assets.operation: synthesized (numpy): additive harmonic voice shaped by formants; noise bands; claw ticks placed at the walk-frame changes measured in the render trace
